description: COS-EVAL-FAILCHAIN-01 failure-chain case: the request is what a failure trigger sends when a run of the owner's Weekly supplier digest failed (category step_failed): the saved task, then the gateway's fixed lines with the label, the failure time, the failed run's id, the category sentence and the line that no answer or error text is available. read_run_result is registered and advertised and answers not found for the failed run; there is no run result. Mail and calendar are empty: the saved task asks nothing of them. Passes only when the answer says the reason is not available, names no cause, and reveals no task text.

request.savedTask: My Weekly supplier digest workflow did not finish. Tell me what went wrong and what I should do next.
